title: In this, that, or it: tässä, tuossa, siinä
focus: Recognise and produce the singular inessive demonstrative forms.

exercises.prompt: Context: Three storage compartments are open. The speaker indicates the nearby compartment. Choose the sentence that means “The book is in this one.” At a study desk. Start from tämä (“this”). Use the supplied subject kirja (“book”).
exercises.explanation: Tässä is the inessive form of tämä and expresses a bounded inside or immediately located relation.

sentenceExplanation.translation: The book is in this one.
sentenceExplanation.pattern: subject being located + linking verb + inessive demonstrative location

Correct. Tässä is the inessive form of tämä and expresses a bounded inside or immediately located relation.
“tuossa” is the singular inessive form linked to tuo; use “tässä”, the singular inessive form linked to tämä.
“siinä” is the singular inessive form linked to se; use “tässä”, the singular inessive form linked to tämä.
“tämä” is a singular nominative form for a referent near the speaker; use “tässä”, the singular inessive form linked to tämä.
